overview: The Arcane Vault Depths store Shar Vahl’s most dangerous arcane artifacts, planar residues, and sealed sigils.
history: The vaults were carved deep beneath the sanctum to contain unstable arcane materials.
Planar dampeners were added after early containment failures.
Sigil locks were developed to secure volatile artifacts.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the vaults were expanded with reinforced chambers.
Shadow-Threat Watch monitors the vaults for planar breaches.
hooks: A sigil lock destabilizes, threatening containment.
A planar residue chamber emits dangerous energy.
An artifact vault shows signs of breach.
A containment pylon overloads during inspection.
